nested / clean.name: Probe trained on clean images only

laundering.sentence: Trained on laundered copies, the 8-way read-out stays at 0.81-0.91 under the launderings tested, but those are close to its training mix (a clean-only probe already gets 0.875 on screenshot_sim, 026 critique). Genuinely new edits such as mild blur or sharpening drop it to about 0.52 (exploratory). Trained on clean images only, it falls to 0.54 after JPEG-75 plus half-size (chance 0.125). File metadata alone already gives 0.69, which is why the probe only sees decoded pixels.

layers.sentence: The middle layers (block 4/8) carry the generator's rendering style; the last, most 'semantic' layer (block 12) carries much less. The b8 minus b12 gap is +0.254.

detector_embeddings.sentence: Detectors trained to say real-vs-fake keep less generator identity in their final embedding: the best one (0.740 at jpeg75_resize05) is 0.118 below DINOv2's own layers; RINE's probe collapsed. This compares detectors at their LAST layer only: at a middle layer Community Forensics reaches 0.883 and beats DINOv2-base (0.856; 026 R1), so it does not show generic features are better.

learning_curve.source: experiments/019-source-diversity/results/tables.md ('Learning curve', mean over held-out sources and per source; jpeg75_resize05, F_b8, FPR reading A)
learning_curve.sentence: Adding more kinds of real photos to training cuts the false-positive rate on an unseen real source from 40% to 7% on average, but AUROC only moves from 0.69 to 0.77: diversity mostly recalibrates the threshold.

unseen_fpr.source: experiments/019-source-diversity/results/tables.md ('Held-out source at k = 5', F_b8, reading A; 'Key secondary')
unseen_fpr.sentence: On a real-photo source the detector never saw, its false-positive rate at the 1% threshold ranges from 0.5% (HDR+ phone finals) to 17% (Unsplash). The 'FPR <= 1% on fresh phone photos' target is untested on modern phones.

open_set.sentence: Asked 'is this from a generator I do not know?', the probe's confidence scores 0.70-0.85 AUROC per generator (mean 0.77), below the pre-set 0.80 bar. Unknown generators are silently labelled as known ones.

near_twins.sentence: Stable Diffusion 1.3 and 1.4 render alike: in every condition the probe tells them apart no better than a coin flip (0.49-0.55, inside the shuffled-label null).

prnu.source: experiments/021-attr-residual/results/prnu_scores.csv; accuracy and PCE-60 summary cross-check: experiments/021-attr-residual/results/tables.md ('(ii) VISION devices')
prnu.sentence: Each photo's sensor-noise residual is correlated with every device's reference fingerprint; the true device lights up on the diagonal (median PCE about 1,000 on native photos) while wrong devices stay near 1-3. Platform copies are weaker but the right device still wins most of the time.
